input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the requirement to disclose and match third-party offers before engaging another provider: it operates as de facto exclusivity and a right of first refusal on us, which our playbook does not accept, and it contradicts Section 12.3 (no exclusivity or most-favoured-customer commitment). If Cobalt needs something here, we could consider a narrow first-look right limited to a defined service category for 12 months that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
input.summary: Delete Section 7.2 disclose-and-match obligation that creates de facto exclusivity on Customer.
